title: Hoc signum crucis (Regensburg 2-3) (Richafort)
desc: Jean Richafort, Hoc signum crucis (Regensburg 2-3). 2 voices (Superius, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Regensburg 2-3. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
